record.excerpt: If you had bought Solana 4 years ago and kept it until today you would have made 48 times your money. … If you had bought Solana 4 years ago and sold everything each time WMA7 crossed down over WMA25 … reinvested all you did get from selling them when WMA7 crossed up over WMA25 … you would have made 85 times your money in 36 risk-free deals spread over 4 years.
record.performance_claim: you would have made 85 times your money in 36 risk-free deals
record.notes: WMA 7/25 cross on SOL, timeframe not stated by author (a reply suggests 8h); striking 85x vs 48x HODL claim, very falsifiable.

spec.claim_summary: Buying Solana and repeatedly selling on WMA7 crossing below WMA25 and rebuying on WMA7 crossing above WMA25 turned initial capital into 85 times over four years.
assumptions: Asset Solana mapped to SOLUSDT Binance spot.
Timeframe not stated; 1d used as most natural reading for a 4-year WMA system with 36 round trips.
Direction is long-only: buy, sell everything to cash, reinvest all proceeds; no shorting.
Initial 'bought 4 years ago' treated as system start date for the claimed period.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Claim starts fully invested at period start ('bought Solana 4 years ago') and holds until the first WMA7 crossed down over WMA25; the engine starts flat and can only enter on WMA7 crossed up over WMA25, so the initial hold from period start to first cross-down is omitted from the testable core.
Rules evaluated on bar closes with next-bar open fills per engine.
No stop-loss, take-profit or time exit stated; exit is only the cross-down.
Period 2020-08-14 to 2024-08-14 inferred from '4 years ago' to 'today' using forum post date 2024-08-14.
85 times interpreted as 85x final equity, encoded as 8400% total return.
36 risk-free deals treated as trade-count description, not encoded as win rate.

evidence.quote: when WMA7 crossed up over WMA25
each time WMA7 crossed down over WMA25
you would have made 85 times your money

issues.problem: Claim starts fully invested at 'bought Solana 4 years ago' and holds until the first 'WMA7 crossed down over WMA25'. Spec starts flat and only enters on 'WMA7 crossed up over WMA25', omitting the initial period-start to first cross-down hold admitted in assumptions. This changes the equity path and 85x total.

Claim starts invested ('bought Solana 4 years ago') and then sells on first cross-down. Spec starts flat with first entry on first WMA7 cross-up, omitting the initial hold from period start to first cross-down, which changes equity curve, trade count and total return.
